ads.text:
A Beautiful Home at Om Sree Gallaxy, Hyderabad by D'LIFE Interiors

From bringing their ideas to life to delivering the entire home in just 40 days, D’LIFE made the journey of creating this home seamless and stress-free. With thoughtful designs, meticulous craftsmanship and attention to every detail, the family found a home that was beautifully theirs. And even after handover, D’LIFE’s continued support gave them the assurance that their home was always taken care of.

#BringHappinessInside

In search of a professional interior design company?

Call: +91 949 508 7777

Email: enquiry@dlifeinteriors.com

Web: www.dlifeinteriors.com

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
